en.download.config.indexers.fields.max_rete: Remove a finished torrent this many days after it completed, even if the share ratio is not reached. Leave empty to wait for the ratio alone.
en.download.config.general.search_budget_se: Seconds allowed for a release search
Indexers slower than this are dropped from the round and the results already returned are kept. Raise it for slow trackers.
en.download.config.stall.samples_hint: Leave empty to never clean up stalled downloads. Removing one deletes the torrent and its files.
en.download.config.stall.interval_minutes_h: How long to wait before sampling a download’s progress again.
en.download.config.stall.min_speed_kib_hint: A check that averages less than this since the previous one counts as stalled, even if the download is still moving.
en.download.config.stall.auto_restart_hint: Look for another release once a stalled download has been removed.
en.download.config.stall.include_manual_gra: Search again for downloads you started yourself too
A stalled download is removed either way — this only decides whether a replacement is searched for.
en.download.config.general.title: General
en.download.config.general.auto_acquisition: No new release is grabbed on its own. Downloads in progress finish and are imported, and you can still grab a release yourself.
en.download.config.general.immediate_search: Search as soon as a title needs a download
When a request is approved, a file is identified or new episodes appear. Off, the next scheduled search handles it.

en.download.config.indexers.title: Indexers
en.download.config.indexers.fields.request_: Minimum time between two search requests sent to this indexer.
en.download.config.indexers.fields.use_for_: Which of these this indexer is queried for. At least one usage is required.
en.download.config.indexers.errors.no_usage: Pick at least one usage for this indexer
en.download.config.indexers.fields.seed_rat: A completed download is removed from the client once it reaches this ratio.
en.download.config.indexers.fields.unknown_: ISO 639-1 code to assume when a release does not name its language.
en.download.config.indexers.stats.empty: No query recorded in the last 30 days.
en.download.config.indexers.actions.clear_c: Query this indexer again right away? Its backoff is there because it failed or asked to be left alone.

en.download.config.queue.actions.cancel_con: Stop this download and remove it from its download client? It leaves the queue either way.
en.download.config.queue.actions.cancel_del: Also delete the files held by the download client
Anything already imported into your library is kept.
en.download.config.history.actions.delete_c: Delete this entry? It only removes the record; no file is touched.
en.download.config.history.errors.still_run: This grab is still running. Cancel it from the queue first.
en.download.config.history.actions.clear_co: Delete every finished, failed and warned entry? Downloads still running are kept.

fr.download.config.general.subtitle: Comportement de récupération et d'import.
fr.download.config.indexers.subtitle: Trackers Torznab interrogés lors d'une recherche de release.
fr.download.config.download_clients.subtitl: Clients auxquels une release récupérée est transmise.
fr.download.config.queue.subtitle: Téléchargements en cours, tous clients confondus.

fr.download.config.history.title: Historique des téléchargements
fr.download.config.history.columns.title: Release
fr.download.config.indexers.fields.max_rete: Supprime un torrent terminé ce nombre de jours après sa fin, même si le ratio de partage n'est pas atteint. Laisser vide pour n'attendre que le ratio.
fr.download.config.general.search_budget_se: Secondes accordées à une recherche de release
Les indexeurs plus lents sont écartés du tour et les résultats déjà reçus sont conservés. À augmenter pour des trackers lents.
fr.download.config.stall.samples: Vérifications avant nettoyage d’un téléchargement bloqué
fr.download.config.stall.samples_hint: Laissez vide pour ne jamais nettoyer les téléchargements bloqués. Supprimer un torrent efface aussi ses fichiers.
fr.download.config.stall.interval_minutes_h: Délai d’attente avant de vérifier à nouveau la progression d’un téléchargement.
fr.download.config.stall.min_speed_kib_hint: Une vérification sous cette moyenne depuis la précédente compte comme bloquée, même si le téléchargement avance encore.
fr.download.config.stall.auto_restart_hint: Cherche une autre release une fois le téléchargement bloqué supprimé.
fr.download.config.stall.include_manual_gra: Relancer aussi une recherche pour les téléchargements lancés manuellement
Un téléchargement bloqué est supprimé dans tous les cas — ceci décide seulement si une autre release est cherchée.
fr.download.config.general.title: Général
fr.download.config.general.auto_acquisition: Aucune release n’est plus récupérée d’elle-même. Les téléchargements en cours se terminent et sont importés, et vous pouvez toujours en récupérer une vous-même.
fr.download.config.general.immediate_search: Chercher dès qu’un titre doit être téléchargé
Quand une demande est approuvée, qu’un fichier est identifié ou que de nouveaux épisodes sortent. Désactivé, la prochaine recherche planifiée s’en charge.
